reason: Article 9 of the EU AI Act pertains to the classification of AI systems and their risk levels. It does not address access control or identity management requirements.
Article 15 of the EU AI Act focuses on transparency and the provision of information to users. It does not contain requirements for implementing SSO, MFA, or access reviews.
Article 17 of the EU AI Act deals with the obligations of users of high-risk AI systems. It does not specify technical controls like SSO, MFA, or access reviews.
